description: This file contains unit tests for the Tenant class in the org.eclipse.hono.service.management.tenant package, verifying encoding, decoding, and behavior of Tenant properties and related configurations.

classes.name: TenantTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of the Tenant class, including serialization/deserialization, property handling, and validation logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a self-signed certificate for use in tests.

methods.name: testDecodeDefault
methods.description: Tests decoding of a Tenant object with default properties (no properties set).

methods.name: testDecodeDisabled
methods.description: Tests decoding of a Tenant object with 'enabled=false'.

methods.name: testDecodeEnabled
methods.description: Tests decoding of a Tenant object with 'enabled=true'.

methods.name: testDecodeExt
methods.description: Tests decoding of the 'ext' section of Tenant.

methods.name: testDecodeAdapters
methods.description: Tests decoding of the 'adapters' section.

methods.name: testDecodeEmptyAdaptersListFails
methods.description: Verifies that an empty adapters list causes decoding failure.

methods.name: testWithMultipleAdapterEntriesOfSameType
methods.description: Ensures multiple adapters of the same type cause decoding failure.

methods.name: testAddAdapterOfAlreadyExistingType
methods.description: Tests adding an adapter of a type that already exists in the tenant.

methods.name: testDecodeMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Tests decoding the 'minimum-message-size' property.

methods.name: testDecodeWithoutMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Tests decoding when 'minimum-message-size' is not set.

methods.name: testDecodeResourceLimits
methods.description: Tests decoding of nested resource limits configuration.

methods.name: testEncodeResourceLimitsDoesNotIncludeDefaultValues
methods.description: Tests encoding a ResourceLimits object, ensuring default values are omitted.

methods.name: testDecodeTrustedCAUsingCert
methods.description: Tests decoding of trusted CA certificates for Tenant.

methods.name: testDecodeTraceSampling
methods.description: Tests decoding of tracing sampling mode configuration.

methods.name: testEncodeDefault
methods.description: Ensures default encoding produces an empty JSON object.

methods.name: testEncodeEnabled
methods.description: Tests encoding of tenant with enabled=true.

methods.name: testEncodeDisabled
methods.description: Tests encoding of tenant with enabled=false.

methods.name: testEncodeMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Tests encoding of minimum-message-size property.

methods.name: testEncodeTraceSamplingModePerAuthId
methods.description: Tests encoding of tracing configuration with sampling modes per authentication ID.

methods.name: testSerializeAdapters
methods.description: Verifies serialization of a Tenant with multiple adapters.
